نتداخل (form VI)

# نَتَدَاخَلَ (natadāḵala) /na.ta.daː.xa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# نُتَدَاخَلَ (nutadāḵala) /nu
